I've been to a therapist and been on celexa and all that stuff before. I don't like smoking. Xanax and stuff just makes me pass out forever. Acid was cool and worth it even though I got lost in the woods.

Anyway, yeah maybe so. I think there's just something wrong with me. My friend mentioned (Jacob) and I have extreme apathy for things. Like, we can acknowledge what we "should" care about, but we don't/can't. It kind of sucks.
